welcomeLead: Your computer is installed and ready. In a few friendly steps we set the clock, make the desktop yours and add tools for learning — then Eduka-Desktop starts.
upstreamThanks: With thanks to Debian and the open-source community.
desktopLead: Everything Eduka-Settings offers for your look: theme, colors, panel, start menu and wallpaper. The preview follows every change; press Apply when you are happy.
appsLead: Hand-picked for schools and students. Apps already on this computer are hidden, and ★ marks our top picks for Edukasaun OS.
goalEducationBody: Bring practical digital tools to schools and learning spaces.
goalAccessBody: Promote free software and reuse suitable computers.
goalSkillsBody: Encourage Tetun, collaboration, and a local developer community.
donationBody: Your optional contribution can help development, learning resources, and community activities.
donationOptional: Edukasaun OS remains free to use.
alwaysShow: Show the Welcome Screen every time I log in
suiteDesktop: The start menu: categories, search, favorites, a Grid or List layout and Tetun translations.
suitePanel: Tasks, tray and clock in four styles. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, battery and drive popups work right on the panel.
suiteSettings: One place for themes, panel, wallpaper, mouse and keyboard, login screen, Parental Control and accessibility.
purposeWord: Light word processor for older computers.
purposeNotes: Handwritten notes and PDF annotations, great with a pen.
purposeAudio: Record and edit audio, podcasts and interviews.
purposeAstronomy: A realistic planetarium: explore the night sky over Timor-Leste.
purposeMonitor: Monitor CPU, memory and running processes.

desktopWarning: Saved for your user account only, in the same files Eduka-Settings uses.

effectsNote: Effects are used only on computers strong enough for them, and never with Eduka Low or high contrast.
pendingCredits: Credits will appear when the project maintainer configures them.
closeBusy: Please wait for the current operation to finish before closing.
notInstalledApp: The required desktop tool is not installed.
purposeAlgebra: Graph calculator for algebra and functions.
purposeMathLab: Mathematical worksheets with installed calculation backends.
purposeLayout: Design posters, brochures and school magazines.
purposePython: The friendliest way to learn Python.
catalogFreshness: Only applications missing from this system are shown. APT availability uses local package indexes.
confirmDetail: Internet access is required. APT requests administrator authentication. Existing applications are checked again before installing.
preflightChanged: The application inventory changed. Review the refreshed list and select again.
timeLead: The list always starts from Dili, Timor-Leste. Pick your time zone and how the clock on Eduka-Panel looks.
noTimezoneMatch: No time zone matches your search.
timeApplying: Applying date and time settings… Administrator authentication may be requested.
timeFailed: The date and time could not be changed. Authentication may have been cancelled.
timedatectlMissing: timedatectl (systemd) is not available on this system.
timeNote: The time zone and system time need administrator authentication. The clock format and face are saved for Eduka-Panel and the Action Center.
suiteLead: Edukasaun OS is a free, open-source operating system made in Timor-Leste and based on Debian GNU/Linux. Its desktop, the Eduka-Desktop Suite, is designed for schools, students and teachers.
toolEus: Edukasaun Update Service: keeps the system up to date and notifies you through Eduka-Panel.
toolKonekta: Classroom chat over the local network, no internet required.
toolBlock: Web filtering for safer learning at school and at home.
helperMissing: Install the Edukasaun Welcome package before installing applications.
finishLead: Thank you for choosing Edukasaun OS. Learn with curiosity, create with confidence and share what you discover.
alwaysShowNote: When unchecked, Eduka-Desktop starts directly at login. You can open the Welcome Screen again from the application menu.
edukaMissing: Eduka-Desktop is not installed in this session. Your choices are saved and used when it starts.
lowResource: Low resource mode for 512 MB RAM / older computers
showMenuText: Show the name beside the icon
visionAccess: High contrast, opaque panels and larger text
hearingAccess: Show network, sound and alert status as text on Eduka-Panel
orcaAccess: Orca screen reader: speak focused applications and menus
accessNote: Orca voice, rate and pitch can be adjusted later in Eduka-Settings → Accessibility.
defaultsRestored: Eduka-Desktop defaults restored. Press Apply to save them.
liquidRequirement: Glass themes need about 2 GB RAM, two CPU threads and a compositor. They use more resources than Eduka Default.
liquidDetected:
Detected memory: {memory} GiB
Logical CPU threads: {threads}
liquidRefused: The glass theme was not enabled to keep this computer stable.
sponsorsLead: Edukasaun OS is free for every school and student thanks to the organizations and people who support it.
becomeSponsorBody: Put your logo here and help bring free digital learning to more schools in Timor-Leste.
contributeBody: Report issues, translate, test and improve the code with the community on GitHub.
logoPlaceholderHint: This space is reserved for a sponsor.
partnerPlaceholderHint: This space is reserved for a partner.
highlightTimorBody: Built for schools, students and teachers, with Tetun at its heart.
highlightFreeBody: Based on Debian GNU/Linux. Free to use, share and improve — forever.
highlightLearningBody: Educational apps, offline resources and accessibility from the first minute.
suiteActionCenter: Calendar, agenda reminders, weather, notifications and Do Not Disturb — one click on the clock.
edukaMissingShort: Eduka-Desktop is not installed in this session.
featureThemesBody: Default, Low, Liquid Glass, Dark, Transparan and MultiColor, plus 17 accent colors.
featureParentalBody: Daily screen-time limits with friendly warnings, protected by the administrator password.
featureLoginBody: Edukasaun login with language, accessibility and keyboard menus.
featureAccessBody: High contrast, status as text and the Orca screen reader.
featureLanguagesBody: Tetun, Portuguese, Indonesian and more, following the system language.
featureLightBody: Low resource mode and Eduka-Low-Theme keep older computers fast.
themeHint_EdukaDefaultTheme: Light and clear; works well on every computer.
themeHint_EdukaLowTheme: Flat and opaque with no effects: the fastest choice for older computers.
themeHint_LiquidGlass: Milky glass with tint and bright rims. Needs about 2 GB RAM; blur needs 3D graphics.
themeHint_EdukasaunDark: Dark for the whole desktop: applications, windows and Eduka-Desktop.
themeHint_EdukaTransparan: Dark glass. Needs about 2 GB RAM and a compositor.
themeHint_EdukaMultiColor: A bright color for every menu category, tile and panel group.
effectsRequirement: Animated effects need about 4 GB RAM and four CPU threads, and are off with Eduka Low.
wallpaperNote: Eduka-Desktop draws the wallpaper itself; a slideshow can be set up later in Eduka-Settings.
applying: Applying… Eduka-Panel and Eduka-Desktop will refresh.
purposeGeogebra: Interactive geometry, algebra and graphs for every school level.
purposeKstars: Desktop planetarium with star charts and an astronomy course.
purposePhysics: Interactive physics simulations: forces, motion and gravity.
purposeGeometry: Interactive geometry constructions for the classroom.
purposeChemistry: Build and view molecules in 3D for chemistry lessons.
purposeFlashcards: Smart flashcards that help you remember what you learn.
purposeQuiz: Make and practise your own quizzes and word lists.
purposeVocabulary: Learn the vocabulary of new languages step by step.
purposeTurtle: Learn programming by drawing with a turtle.
purposeBrain: Logic puzzles, mental arithmetic and memory games.
purposeSandbox: Build and explore block worlds together (Minetest).
purposeMu: Simple Python editor for beginners and micro:bit.
purposeVscodium: Full code editor for advanced students.
purposeArduino: Program Arduino boards for electronics and robotics.
purposePdf: Read and annotate PDF books and documents.
purposeLibrary: Organize and convert your e-book library.
purposeWiki: A desktop wiki for notes and study plans.
purposeJoplin: Notes and to-do lists that sync between devices.
purposeLightBrowser: Lightweight web browser for older computers.
purposeElement: Secure, open chat for schools and teams (Matrix).
purposeMusic: Make music with instruments, beats and loops.
purposePaint: Simple painting program for drawings and pictures.
purposeCad: 3D design for engineering and technical drawing.
purposeDisks: Check, format and manage disks and USB sticks.
purposeClean: Free disk space and remove traces.
purposeFlatseal: Review and change Flatpak app permissions.
purposeKeyboard: On-screen keyboard for touch screens and motor impairments.
